propositions: Test test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer kills its xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to timeout (91.6s idle, 504.8s under CPU saturation exceeds 300s CI budget).
Single monolithic test loop processes 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns unboundedly, with cost scaling with load contention.
pytest-timeout --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from timer thread, killing worker outright with no traceback instead of test failure.
Test must be chunk-parametrized with fixed-size batches (_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) to bound per-test cost independent of corpus size and load.
All 884 units must remain compared byte-identically against oracle with real pandoc (_EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE=1); chunking spreads work across xdist workers.
Coverage guard test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit must verify chunks concatenate to _renderable_units() with count >= 100 to prevent silent unit drops.
